sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Burnham set out three tests for agreements, including consistency with Labour's manifesto pledge of no return to the single market, customs union, or freedom of movement. sections.heading: What happens next

However, Burnham ruled out major changes before the next general election, stating a public mandate is required.
